Plyo Package

$398.00$244.06

Move faster. Jump higher. Train harder. The YORK Plyo Performance System and the Plyo Performance Plus combine explosive power, conditioning, agility, and mobility into one complete training package. Whether you’re improving athletic performance, burning calories, or adding more variety to your workouts, they helps you build speed, power, coordination, and the kind of fitness that moves with you every day.

What's Included

  • Plyo Performance System
  • 3-in-1 Plyo Box – Three jump heights in one compact box let you safely progress as your confidence and explosive power grow.
  • Battle Rope – Build full-body strength and conditioning through challenging, low-impact workouts.
  • Yoga Mat – Create a comfortable space for warm-ups, mobility, stretching, and recovery.
  • Resistance Bands: Yellow (30–65 lb), Purple (35–80 lb), Green (40–95 lb), Red (45–115 lb) – Add strength, mobility, activation, and travel-friendly workouts to your training.
  • PVC Jump Rope – Improve coordination, footwork, agility, and cardiovascular endurance almost anywhere.
  • Plyo Performance System Plus
  • Everything in the Plyo Performance System, plus:
  • 15 lb Slam Ball – Add explosive power, rotational strength, and dynamic full-body exercises.
  • Complete Resistance Band Set: All eight resistance bands from 10–150 lb – Unlock even more resistance levels for strength training, mobility, assisted pull-ups, and progression.

Why The Plyo Package?

Every tool in this system helps improve a different aspect of fitness, creating balanced workouts that translate into better movement, greater confidence, and more energy both inside and outside the gym.

Key Detail #1

Build Explosive Power: Train with box steps or jumps, battle ropes, jump rope, and slam ball exercises that develop speed, coordination, balance, and athletic movement.

Key Detail #2

Endless Workout Variety: From conditioning circuits and HIIT sessions to mobility work and recovery, every piece of equipment complements the others to create hundreds of workout combinations.

Key Detail #3

Complete Fitness. Compact Space. Every component is portable, easy to store, and designed to work together, giving you a complete conditioning system without filling your garage or spare room.

Performance Your Body in Motion

Jump, carry, slam, pull, stretch, and recover with one thoughtfully designed system that builds strength, speed, endurance, and coordination through natural, full-body movement.

Equipment

Fitness should be more than lifting weights. The YORK Plyo Performance System combines complementary training tools that help you jump, sprint, move, stabilize, recover, and build endurance. All from one compact package. Every piece has been selected to create workouts that stay engaging, challenging, and never repetitive. Whether you’re training for sports, improving overall fitness, or simply looking for a fun way to stay active, this system helps you move better for life.
